source.text: በእማንቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ ርእየ፡ ኖኅ፡ ምድረ፡ ከመ፡ አድነነት፡ ወከመ፡ ቅሩብ፡ ሕጕላ።
source.note: Actual complete Charles1906 main-text photographs155–159 and v2 detail crops inspected. Selected print signs preserved; raised apparatus numbers excluded, punctuation normalized. Author accepts this selected-edition proposal pending independent exact review.

translation.text: In those days Noah saw that the earth had tilted and that its destruction was near.[a]

footnotes.text: Actual primary Dillmann1117 explicitly cites65:1 under inclining or bending the earth, supporting tilted rather than an unexamined generic calamity. The selected subject remains Noah, the earth is the thing inclining, and its destruction is near; no flood date or further cause is inserted.

source.text: ወ*አንሥአ፡ እገሪሁ፡ እምህየ፡ ወሖረ፡ እስከ፡ አጽናፈ፡ ምድር፡ ወጸርኀ፡ ለእምሔው፡ ሄኖክ፡ ወይቤ፡ ኖኅ፡ በቃል፡ መራር፡ ስምዐኒ፡ ስምዐኒ፡ ስምዐኒ፡ *ሣልስ።
source.note: Actual complete Charles1906 main-text photographs155–159 and v2 detail crops inspected. Selected print signs preserved; raised apparatus numbers excluded, punctuation normalized. Author accepts this selected-edition proposal pending independent exact review.

translation.text: He set out from there and went to the ends of the earth. Noah cried out to his grandfather Enoch in a bitter voice, saying three times, “Hear me, hear me, hear me!”[a]

footnotes.text: Actual primary Dillmann727 supports grandfather and explicitly cites65:2. Newly inspected primary165 controls bitter,231 explicitly cites65:2 under three-times usage, and635–636 supports setting out by the feet. All three printed hear-me cries remain; apparatus callouts are not source numerals. The narrator shifts from third-person Noah to first-person speech in the following unit.

source.text: ወእቤሎ፡ ንግረኒ፡ ምንት፡ *ውእቱ፡ ዘይትገበር፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡ እስመ፡ ከመዝ፡ ሰርሐት፡ ምድር፡ ወአንቀልቅለት፡ ዮጊ፡ አነ፡ አትኀጐል፡ ምስሌሃ።
source.note: Actual complete Charles1906 main-text photographs155–159 and v2 detail crops inspected. Selected print signs preserved; raised apparatus numbers excluded, punctuation normalized. Author accepts this selected-edition proposal pending independent exact review.

translation.text: I said to him, “Tell me what is happening on the earth. The earth is so exhausted and shaken; perhaps I will be destroyed with it.”[a]

footnotes.text: Actual primary Dillmann342 explicitly cites65:3 under being exhausted or afflicted, not merely working or functioning; exhausted replaces the first proposal’s vague troubled. Primary412 supports shaking/wavering,1075–1076 gives the perhaps particle with an explicit65:3 reference. The emphatic I is retained without adding an unprinted named speaker or a certainty that he will perish.

source.text: ወበድኅረ፡ ውእቱ፡ ጊዜ፡ ኮነ፡ ሁከት፡ ዐቢይ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡ ወተሰምዐ፡ ቃል፡ እምሰማይ፡ ወወደቅኩ፡ በገጽየ።
source.note: Actual complete Charles1906 main-text photographs155–159 and v2 detail crops inspected. Selected print signs preserved; raised apparatus numbers excluded, punctuation normalized. Author accepts this selected-edition proposal pending independent exact review.

translation.text: After that time a great disturbance arose on the earth. A voice was heard from heaven, and I fell on my face.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected after-that-time phrase and actual primary1109–1110 post/after range are retained. The source then has a great disturbance, a voice heard from heaven and I fell on my face. The narrator remains first person; no unprinted personal name is given to the voice.

source.text: ወመጽአ፡ ሄኖክ፡ እምሔው*የ፡ ወቆመ፡ ኀቤየ፡ ወይቤለኒ፡ በምንት፡ ጸራኅከ፡ ኀቤየ፡ ጽራኀ፡ መሪር፡ ወብካየ።
source.note: Actual complete Charles1906 main-text photographs155–159 and v2 detail crops inspected. Selected print signs preserved; raised apparatus numbers excluded, punctuation normalized. Author accepts this selected-edition proposal pending independent exact review.

translation.text: My grandfather Enoch came and stood beside me. He said to me, “Why have you cried out to me with a bitter cry and weeping?”[a]

footnotes.text: The selected text calls Enoch my grandfather; actual primary727 controls that kinship. Actual primary165 gives bitter and1275 explicitly cites65:5 under cry/clamor. The why question, bitter cry and weeping remain, without adding a cause or softening the lament. The actual source star within the grandfather suffix is retained.

source.text: ወትእዛዝ፡ ወጽአ፡ እምቅድመ፡ *ገጸ፡ እግዚአ፡ ዲበ፡ እለ፡ የኀድሩ፡ የብሰ፡ ከመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ይኩን፡ ኅልቀቶሙ፡ እስመ፡ አእመሩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ኀቡአተ፡ መላእክት፡ ወኵሎ፡ ግፍዐ፡ ሰይጣናት፡ ወኵሎ፡ ኅይሎሙ፡ *ኅቡአ፡ ኅይለት፡ *ወኵሎ፡ ኅይሎሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ይገብር፡ ሥራያተ፡ ወኅይሎሙ፡ ለኅብራት፡ ወኅይሎሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ይሰብኩ፡ ስብከ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ምድር።
source.note: Actual complete Charles1906 main-text photographs155–159 and v2 detail crops inspected. Selected print signs preserved; raised apparatus numbers excluded, punctuation normalized. HOLD: Primary245 supports sorcery,598 joining/connection and575–576 destruction/count vocabulary, but the exact selected repeated-power list and bindings/charms noun remain unresolved. Basic joining does not by itself establish spells. No new image/idol object is added to the casting clause.

translation.text: A command has gone out from before the Lord’s face concerning those who dwell on dry land, that this should be their end. They have learned all the hidden things of the angels, all the violence of the satans and all their hidden power, all the power of those who practice sorcery, their power of spells, and the power of those who cast molten things for the whole earth.[a]

footnotes.text: Not ready for publication: Primary245 supports sorcery,598 joining/connection and575–576 destruction/count vocabulary, but the exact selected repeated-power list and bindings/charms noun remain unresolved. Basic joining does not by itself establish spells. No new image/idol object is added to the casting clause.

source.text: ወእፎ፡ ይትወለድ፡ ብሩር፡ እምብለ፡ ምድር፡ ወእፎ፡ ይከውን፡ ነጠብጣብ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር።
source.note: Actual complete Charles1906 main-text photographs155–159 and v2 detail crops inspected. Selected print signs preserved; raised apparatus numbers excluded, punctuation normalized. Author accepts this selected-edition proposal pending independent exact review.

translation.text: They know how silver is produced without the earth, and how easily melted metal comes into being on the earth.[a]

footnotes.text: The actual selected preposition is transcribedእምብለ, not the first proposal’s miscopyእምከበለ. It expresses exclusion, without, corresponding to the actual primaryDillmann773–774 exclusion prepositionእንበለ (praeter, excepto, sine). The selected printed spelling is retained, not silently normalized to the dictionary headword; no dust noun is printed here. Silver is controlled by501–502. Easily melted metal follows697, metallum quod facile liquescit, without a modern alloy identification. They know is carried from the preceding list; this unit itself begins and how.

source.text: እስመ፡ ብሩር፡ ወናእክ፡ ኢይትወለድ፡ እምድር፡ *ከመ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ ነቅዕ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘያወልዶሙ፡ ወመልአክ፡ ይቀውም፡ ውስቴቱ፡ ወይበድር፡ ውእቱ፡ መልአክ።
source.note: Actual complete Charles1906 main-text photographs155–159 and v2 detail crops inspected. Selected print signs preserved; raised apparatus numbers excluded, punctuation normalized. HOLD: Actual primary540 explicitly cites65:8 in go-before/take-precedence range, supporting the final angel verb. That does not settle the selected first/spring/because/as construction. Preserve the negative and literal spring; do not certify the whole as-at-first attachment from the one verb.

translation.text: Silver and tin are not produced from the earth as at first. A spring produces them, and an angel stands within it; that angel takes the lead.[a]

footnotes.text: Not ready for publication: Actual primary540 explicitly cites65:8 in go-before/take-precedence range, supporting the final angel verb. That does not settle the selected first/spring/because/as construction. Preserve the negative and literal spring; do not certify the whole as-at-first attachment from the one verb.

source.text: ወእምድኅረ*ዝ፡ አኀዘኒ፡ እምሔውየ፡ ሄኖክ፡ በእዴየ፡ ወአንሥአኒ፡ ወይቤለኒ፡ ሑር፡ እስመ፡ ተሳእልክዎ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መንፈስት፡ በእንተዝ፡ ሁከት፡ ዘዲበ፡ ምድር።
source.note: Actual complete Charles1906 main-text photographs155–159 and v2 detail crops inspected. Selected print signs preserved; raised apparatus numbers excluded, punctuation normalized. Author accepts this selected-edition proposal pending independent exact review.

translation.text: After this my grandfather Enoch took me by the hand and raised me. He said to me, “Go, for I have asked the Lord of Spirits about this disturbance on the earth.”[a]

footnotes.text: The text has my grandfather, my hand and raised me, then his address to me reporting I asked. Those shifts are retained. No newly identified heavenly messenger replaces Enoch or the Lord of Spirits. The source star on after-this remains in the diplomatic text.

source.text: ወይቤለኒ፡ በእንተ፡ ዐመጾሙ፡ ተፈጽመት፡ ኵነኔሆሙ፡ †ወኢይትኄለቁ፡ በቅድምየ፡ በእንተ፡ †አውራኅ፡ ዘአእመሩ፡ ወአከመ፡ ምድር፡ ትትኀጐል፡ ወእለ፡ የኀድሩ፡ ዲቤሃ።
source.note: Actual complete Charles1906 main-text photographs155–159 and v2 detail crops inspected. Selected print signs preserved; raised apparatus numbers excluded, punctuation normalized. HOLD: Actual primary577 establishes counting as a possible selected root. Printed118n24–25 proposes reconstructed restrained/sorceries alternatives, but those are not adopted. The selected daggered negative-counting/months clauses remain held; accessible lexical entries do not erase the critical syntax.

translation.text: He said to me, “Because of their wrongdoing their condemnation has been completed. They will not be counted before me because of the months they have learned, and how the earth will be destroyed along with those who dwell on it.”[a]

footnotes.text: Not ready for publication: Actual primary577 establishes counting as a possible selected root. Printed118n24–25 proposes reconstructed restrained/sorceries alternatives, but those are not adopted. The selected daggered negative-counting/months clauses remain held; accessible lexical entries do not erase the critical syntax.

source.text: ወእሉሰ፡ ምግባእ፡ አልቦሙ፡ ለዓለም፡ እስመ፡ አርአይዎሙ፡ ዘኀቡአ፡ ወእለ፡ ተኰነኑ፡ ወለከሰ፡ አንተ፡ ወልድየ፡ አእመረ፡ እግዚአ፡ መንፈስት፡ እስመ፡ ንጹሕ፡ ወኄር፡ አንተ፡ እምንቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘኀቡአት።
source.note: Actual complete Charles1906 main-text photographs155–159 and v2 detail crops inspected. Selected print signs preserved; raised apparatus numbers excluded, punctuation normalized. HOLD: Actual primary1173 controls return and610 good, with explicit65:11 references. Printed118n29 discusses repentance through a Greek/Hebrew explanation, not a newly inspected original. The selected return/hidden-showing/condemned relative and purity-from-hidden-things syntax remain held. No silent repentance substitution.

translation.text: These have no return forever, because they showed them what was hidden, and those who were condemned. But as for you, my son, the Lord of Spirits knows that you are pure and good from all these hidden things.[a]

footnotes.text: Not ready for publication: Actual primary1173 controls return and610 good, with explicit65:11 references. Printed118n29 discusses repentance through a Greek/Hebrew explanation, not a newly inspected original. The selected return/hidden-showing/condemned relative and purity-from-hidden-things syntax remain held. No silent repentance substitution.

source.text: ወአጽንዐ፡ ስመከ፡ በማእከለ፡ ቅዱሳን፡ ወይዕቀበከ፡ እምእለ፡ ይነብሩ፡ ዲበ፡ የብስ፡ ወአጽንዐ፡ ለዘርእከ፡ ዘጽድቅ፡ ለነገሥት፡ ወለሥልጣናት፡ ዐበይት፡ ወእምዘርእከ፡ ይወጽእ፡ ነቅዐ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ወቅዱሳን፡ ወ*አልቦ፡ ኅልቈሙ፡ ለዓለም።
source.note: Actual complete Charles1906 main-text photographs155–159 and v2 detail crops inspected. Selected print signs preserved; raised apparatus numbers excluded, punctuation normalized. HOLD: Actual primary1290 explicitly supports establishing/strengthening65:12. The for-kings/great-authorities attachment remains unsettled; strength vocabulary does not resolve that construction. Keep the source/seed and no-count clauses complete.

translation.text: He has established your name among the holy ones and will preserve you from those who dwell on dry land. He has established your righteous offspring for kings and great authorities. From your offspring a spring of righteous and holy ones will come forth, and there is no counting them forever.[a]

footnotes.text: Not ready for publication: Actual primary1290 explicitly supports establishing/strengthening65:12. The for-kings/great-authorities attachment remains unsettled; strength vocabulary does not resolve that construction. Keep the source/seed and no-count clauses complete.

source.text: ወእምድኅረዝ፡ አርአየኒ፡ መላእክተ፡ መቅሠፍት፡ *እለ፡ ድልዋን፡ ከመ፡ *ይመጽኡ፡ ወይፈትሑ፡ ኵሎ፡ ኀይለ፡ ማይ፡ ዘመትሕተ፡ ምድር፡ ከመ፡ ይኩን፡ ለኵነኔ፡ ወለአስተርእዮ፡ ለኵሉ፡ እለ፡ ይነብሩ፡ [ወየኀድሩ]፡ ዲበ፡ የብስ።
source.note: Actual complete Charles1906 main-text photographs155–159 and v2 detail crops inspected. Selected print signs preserved; raised apparatus numbers excluded, punctuation normalized. HOLD: Actual primary1081 gives ready/prepared, but does not establish the exact showing/revelation derived noun or its role beside judgment. The bracketed dwell clause and cross-page body remain complete. This unit is not approved through the clearer readiness clause alone.

translation.text: After this he showed me the angels of punishment, ready to come and release all the power of the water beneath the earth, to bring judgment and revelation to all who live and dwell on dry land.[a]

footnotes.text: Not ready for publication: Actual primary1081 gives ready/prepared, but does not establish the exact showing/revelation derived noun or its role beside judgment. The bracketed dwell clause and cross-page body remain complete. This unit is not approved through the clearer readiness clause alone.

source.text: ወአዘዘ፡ እግዚአ፡ መናፍስት፡ መላእክተ፡ እለ፡ ይመጽኡ፡ ከመ፡ አኢያንሥኡ፡ እደወ፡ ወይዕቀቡ፡ እስመ፡ እሎን፡ መላእክት፡ ዲበ፡ ኀይለ፡ ማያት፡ ሀለዉ።
source.note: Actual complete Charles1906 main-text photographs155–159 and v2 detail crops inspected. Selected print signs preserved; raised apparatus numbers excluded, punctuation normalized. HOLD: Actual primary635–636 covers lifting/raising, but the selected unusual initial negative/raising glyph sequence still requires exact same-font and derived-form adjudication. No dictionary or better-known spelling is silently substituted for that selected form.

translation.text: The Lord of Spirits commanded the angels who were coming not to raise their hands but to keep watch, because these angels were over the power of the waters.[a]

footnotes.text: Not ready for publication: Actual primary635–636 covers lifting/raising, but the selected unusual initial negative/raising glyph sequence still requires exact same-font and derived-form adjudication. No dictionary or better-known spelling is silently substituted for that selected form.

source.text: ወመጻእኩ፡ እም*ቅድሞ፡ ገጸ፡ ሄኖክ።
source.note: Actual complete Charles1906 main-text photographs155–159 and v2 detail crops inspected. Selected print signs preserved; raised apparatus numbers excluded, punctuation normalized. Author accepts this selected-edition proposal pending independent exact review.

translation.text: I came away from before Enoch’s face.[a]

footnotes.text: The narrator remains first person and leaves from before Enoch’s face. Before/face is not silently replaced by a new destination; the actual star attached to the before-expression remains. This short unit ends before LXVII.

source.text: ወበእማንቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ ኮነ፡ ቃለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኀቤየ፡ ወይቤለኒ፡ ኖኅ፡ ክፍልከ፡ በጽሐ፡ ኀቤየ፡ ክፍል፡ ዘአልቦት፡ ሕስ፡ ክፍል፡ ፍቅር፡ ወርትዕ።
source.note: Actual complete Charles1906 main-text photographs155–159 and v2 detail crops inspected. Selected print signs preserved; raised apparatus numbers excluded, punctuation normalized. Author accepts this selected-edition proposal pending independent exact review.

translation.text: In those days the word of God came to me and said, “Noah, your portion has come before me, a portion without guilt, a portion of love and uprightness.”[a]

footnotes.text: Actual primary Dillmann125 gives the selectedሕስ noun a fault, blame or guilt range; guilt is not inferred from a later English edition. Primary878 gives portion/share. The repeated portion, no-guilt, love and uprightness language is retained without replacing it with a later personal-status formula.

source.text: ወይእዜኒ፡ ይገብሩ፡ መላእክት፡ ዕፀወ፡ ወሶበ፡ ወድኡ፡ ለውእቱ፡ መላእክት፡ አወዲ፡ እዴየ፡ ዲቦ፡ ወእዕቀቦ፡ ወትከውን፡ እምኔሁ፡ ዘርእ፡ ሕይወት፡ ወተውላጥ፡ ይኩን፡ ከመ፡ ኢይነብር፡ የብስ፡ ዕራቁ።
source.note: Actual complete Charles1906 main-text photographs155–159 and v2 detail crops inspected. Selected print signs preserved; raised apparatus numbers excluded, punctuation normalized. Author accepts this selected-edition proposal pending independent exact review.

translation.text: Now the angels are working wood. When the angels have completed it, I will put my hand upon it and preserve it. A seed of life will come from it, and there will be a replacement so that dry land will not remain bare.[a]

footnotes.text: Working wood retains the selected wood material rather than adding the word ark or a described vessel. Actual primary1025–1026 gives wood/tree and wooden implements;525 supports entering/coming-from,889–890 change/exchange/replacement, and962 explicitly cites67:2 for bare. Angels finish the work before the first-person hand/preservation promise. Seed of life and the negative not-remain-bare are retained; the object is not supplied with an unprinted name.

translation.text: Judgment comes upon them because they trust in the pleasure of their flesh and deny the spirit of the Lord.[a]

Both agency and the causal judgment clause are retained without turning the statement into a modern theory of the body.
